w10_T4_001664: In the morning, Maya had 150 stickers in her collection. By midday she had traded away 30 of them to a friend for a poster. In the afternoon, a sticker vending machine replaced every sticker she had left with 5 shiny new ones. That evening, her sticker count doubled again when her cousin mailed her a matching set. Right after that, she found 3 more stickers tucked inside an old notebook, and later her aunt mailed her a big envelope holding 66 more, all within a stretch of time that felt like a full 60 minutes. How many stickers did Maya have after her aunt's envelope arrived?
w10_T4_001667: Jake's lemonade stand cash box held $148 at the start of the day. A neighboring stand collected a stray $20 bill that a customer meant for napkins, so that money never touched Jake's box. During the morning rush the box grew by $46, then by another $26 from the after-school crowd, and by $34 more from a big group order. Before closing, a good-sales-day bonus turned every dollar in the box into 4 dollars. Right after that, a local business match program turned every dollar into 8 dollars. How much money was in Jake's cash box after the business match program finished?
w10_T4_001670: Priya kept a single jar of glass marbles that held 238 marbles one Saturday morning. During a game with friends she won 33 more marbles, then found 21 additional ones under the porch. At lunch, her little brother borrowed a dozen cookies from the pantry for a snack, which had nothing to do with the marbles, but Priya still had to pay back 253 marbles she owed her cousin from an old bet. That afternoon, a marble-trading event that took two hours, or 120 minutes, to organize turned every marble she had into 6 new ones, and later a bonus round turned each of those into 9 more. Finally, she gave 128 marbles to her cousin as a thank-you gift. How many marbles did Priya have in her jar after giving the thank-you gift?
w10_T4_001672: Liam started a new video game level with 39 points already banked from a bonus. A power-up turned every point he had into 9 points. Then a combo turned each of those into 7 more points. He also found a hidden dozen coins in a secret room, which didn't affect his score at all. Landing a rare achievement added 72 points to his total, but a trap immediately after cost him 1132 points. A final treasure chest then turned every remaining point into 5 points. What was Liam's point total after opening the treasure chest?
w10_T4_001675: Grandma Rosa's classroom library began the semester with 133 books on its shelves. She donated 43 books to a sister school in need. A publisher then sent 53 brand-new books as a grant reward. When the reading club reorganized, every book on the shelf was matched with 6 duplicate copies for a book fair display, set up with help from a dozen or so volunteers. The fair brought in 24 more donated books afterward. At the end of the semester, 765 books were shipped off to a regional donation center. How many books remained on Rosa's classroom shelves after the shipment?
w10_T4_001679: In the morning, Farmer Ben collected 172 eggs from the henhouse. Later that morning he found 61 more eggs in a second coop. By afternoon, 15 eggs had cracked and had to be thrown out. That evening, a new hatching machine turned every remaining egg into 7 fresh eggs, and right after, a delivery run turned each of those into 9 more. Before the day ended, a shipment of 2185 eggs was sent off to the local market. How many eggs did Farmer Ben have left after the shipment left?
w10_T4_001690: In the morning, Sofia had 12 tokens saved up from the arcade. A jackpot machine turned every token she had into 9 tokens. She then split her tokens evenly among 4 prize bins and kept only the tokens from one bin for herself. That afternoon she noticed a poster advertising a raffle worth 500 tickets, but she didn't enter it. She then earned 22 more tokens from a claw machine win, and that evening a staff member gave her 64 more for being a loyal customer. Right before leaving, she spent 84 tokens on a stuffed bear, a purchase the arcade said was worth about 2 dollars in ticket value, or 200 cents. How many tokens did Sofia have after buying the stuffed bear?
w10_T4_001692: Ethan's piggy bank held $68 saved from odd jobs around the house. He earned $15 more for mowing a neighbor's lawn. He then spent $34 on a new bike helmet. A birthday gift afterward turned every dollar in the piggy bank into 7 dollars. Right after that, Ethan paid $326 toward a new bicycle. How much money was left in Ethan's piggy bank after buying the bicycle?
w10_T4_001695: Oscar had 171 coins in his collection box at the start of summer. A rare coin dealer offered to turn every coin he had into 3 coins of higher value, and Oscar agreed to the trade. He then paid 491 coins to enter a collectors' auction. During the auction he also had to give up 18 coins as an entry fee adjustment. He won back 21 coins in a raffle prize. Later, he traded away 14 coins for a display case and gave 5 more to his little sister as a keepsake, all in an afternoon that felt like it stretched a mere 60 minutes into what seemed like two hours. How many coins did Oscar have after giving coins to his sister?
w10_T4_001702: In the morning, Diego had $218 saved in his savings account. By midday he had earned $49 more from a weekend job. That afternoon, a bank promotion doubled the money in his account. In the evening, a birthday check for $69 arrived and was added to his balance. Right before the bank closed for the night, a final loyalty bonus turned every dollar in his account into 6 dollars. How much money was in Diego's savings account after the loyalty bonus was applied?
w10_T4_001703: Ava had 13 party favors left after her birthday celebration, while her friend Ben had 47 party favors of his own that day. Ava's grandmother then turned every favor she had into 5 new party favors as a surprise. Ava gave 3 favors to her teacher as a thank-you gift. Later, her aunt gave her 18 more favors for a class project. Finally, Ava used 49 favors to decorate the school bulletin board. How many party favors did Ava have left after decorating the bulletin board?
w10_T4_001706: In the morning, Marcus had 88 baseball cards in his binder, while his friend Tony had 102 cards in his own collection. By midday, Marcus traded away 41 cards at a card show. That afternoon, a rare booster pack turned every card he had left into 5 new cards. In the evening, he found 4 more cards under his bed. Right before bedtime, he mailed 170 cards to his cousin as a gift. How many baseball cards did Marcus have left after mailing the gift to his cousin?
w10_T4_001713: The Riverside Food Pantry started the week with 172 cans of soup on its shelves. A local grocery store donated 33 more cans. A church group added another 58 cans the next day. A volunteer accidentally logged a dozen canned peaches that were actually returned to the grocery store, so those never counted toward the pantry's soup total. The pantry then had to send 62 cans to a sister location across town. A supply drive afterward turned every can on the shelf into 6 cans, and a second matching drive turned each of those into 7 more. How many cans of soup did the pantry have on its shelves after the second matching drive?
w10_T4_001716: In the morning, a courier named Wes had 119 packages loaded in his van. By midday he picked up 48 more packages from the depot. That afternoon he delivered 119 packages to a large office building. In the evening he picked up 63 more packages for a late round. Right before his shift ended, he handed off 29 packages to another driver during a stop that lasted half an hour, or 30 minutes. How many packages did Wes have in his van after handing off packages to the other driver?
w10_T4_001731: Camille's charity jar held $92 after the weekend bake sale. She split the money evenly into 4 identical envelopes for different charities and kept only one envelope for the local shelter. She then spent $1 on a stamp to mail a thank-you note. A generous donor added $14 more to the shelter's envelope. A matching sponsor then turned every dollar in the envelope into 9 dollars, and a final grant turned each of those into 8 dollars, a process the shelter director said took about 90 minutes, or an hour and a half, from start to finish. How much money was in Camille's envelope after the final grant was applied?
w10_T4_001732: In the morning, a food truck had 56 tacos prepped for the day. Right after opening, 1 taco was dropped and had to be thrown out. By midday, the cooks prepped 39 more tacos for the lunch rush. In the afternoon, they prepped 30 additional tacos ahead of a big event. That evening, 75 tacos were sold to a catering client. Right before closing, a bulk order from a food blogger turned every remaining taco into 8 tacos for a viral recipe video, a shoot the crew joked took '60 minutes, or a whole hour' to set up. How many tacos did the food truck have after the bulk order for the blogger?
w10_T4_001738: The supply closet at Lincoln Elementary held 154 pencils at the start of the term. A donation drive added 24 more pencils to the closet. A bulk order then turned every pencil in the closet into 7 pencils, delivered in a shipment the janitor said took '120 minutes, or two full hours' to unload. The PTA then donated 39 more pencils. Finally, 266 pencils were handed out to classrooms for a school-wide art project. How many pencils were left in the supply closet after the pencils were handed out?
w10_T4_001741: A warehouse had 178 boxes of cereal on a single pallet at the start of the week. On Monday, 151 boxes were shipped out to a grocery chain. On Tuesday, 25 more boxes were sent to a different store. On Wednesday, a supplier delivered 15 more boxes to replace a damaged batch. On Thursday, another delivery brought 61 more boxes, arriving in a truck that had been on the road for '180 minutes, or three hours.' How many boxes of cereal were on the pallet after Thursday's delivery?
w10_T4_001751: A toy store had 142 yo-yos in stock at the start of the month. A new shipment brought in 9 more yo-yos. A defective batch of 44 yo-yos had to be returned to the manufacturer. A second shipment then added 62 more yo-yos to the shelf. A big weekend sale moved 117 yo-yos out the door. Afterward, a wholesale deal turned every remaining yo-yo into 9 yo-yos, a deal that closed in what the manager called '60 minutes, or a single hour.' How many yo-yos were in stock after the wholesale deal?
w10_T4_001753: The Willow Creek Library had 225 novels on its new-release shelf at the start of spring. A publisher's donation added 54 more novels to the shelf. A book club member mentioned a dozen new releases coming next month, though those hadn't arrived yet and didn't count toward the shelf. A second donation brought in 74 more novels. During a spring clearance, 210 novels were sold at a fundraiser. Finally, 99 more novels were transferred to a branch library across town. How many novels remained on the new-release shelf after the transfer to the branch library?
w10_T4_001754: Lily had 47 seashells in her bucket after a morning at the beach, while her brother Sam had found only 19 seashells in his own bucket. Lily gave 12 seashells to a tide-pool tour guide as a thank-you. She then dropped 3 shells while climbing over some rocks. A sudden wave swept away 27 more shells before she could grab them. She accidentally left 2 shells behind on a picnic table that also held a stack of 15 napkins nobody touched. That evening, a shell-crafting kit turned every shell she still had into 9 polished shells. How many polished shells did Lily end up with?
w10_T4_001756: A factory had 228 gears in a storage bin at the start of the shift. Workers added 38 more gears from a delayed shipment. A supervisor mentioned that a dozen wrenches were missing from the toolroom, though that had nothing to do with the gear count. A new assembly line then turned every gear in the bin into 6 gears. A second line turned each of those into 9 gears. A large customer order then required shipping out 1492 gears, followed by another order for 2169 gears, and a final rush order for 7544 gears. How many gears were left in the storage bin after the last rush order shipped?
w10_T4_001765: A farmer named Hugo had 107 watermelons ready for market at the start of the harvest. A neighboring farm's trade turned every watermelon he had into 3 watermelons, and a second trade with a bigger orchard turned each of those into 7 watermelons. A truck accident on the way to market destroyed 883 watermelons. A wholesale deal then turned every remaining watermelon into 9 watermelons, a deal finalized in what Hugo's daughter called '120 minutes, or two hours' of negotiating. A big grocery chain bought 1608 watermelons in one order, but a roadside stand later returned 28 unsold watermelons to Hugo. How many watermelons did Hugo have after the roadside stand's return?
w10_T4_001769: In the morning, Grace had $57 in her wallet. She split her money evenly into 3 equal parts and gave two parts away to charity, keeping only one part for herself. By afternoon she had spent $12 on lunch. That evening, a mall promotion turned every dollar she still had into 4 dollars, a promotion that ran for exactly '60 minutes, or one hour.' Right before heading home, she spent $7 on a bus ticket. How much money did Grace have left after buying the bus ticket?
w10_T4_001776: In the morning, a flower shop had 135 roses in the cooler. A wholesale delivery turned every rose into 9 fresh roses to restock for a big wedding order. By afternoon, 148 roses were used for wedding centerpieces. Later that afternoon, 44 more roses were sold to walk-in customers. That evening, a large corporate event order took 802 roses all at once. Right before closing, a supplier dropped off 34 more roses for the next day. How many roses were in the cooler after the supplier's evening drop-off?
